## Summary

I resolved ticket T-5006 by identifying why the catalog-reindex process hasn't run since Wednesday. The root cause is that the Job's main `reindex` container completed successfully, but the `cloud-sql-proxy` sidecar container continues running indefinitely, preventing the Job from completing. With `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid`, this blocks all subsequent scheduled runs. The fix is to either move the proxy to init containers with `restartPolicy: Always` to make it a proper sidecar, or add a lifecycle hook to terminate it gracefully when the main job finishes.
